summary: Global Mofy AI Limited, a Cayman-incorporated, Beijing-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K confirming completion on November 6, 2026, of a self-underwritten registered direct offering originally contracted October 30, 2026. The company sold 45,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$0.22 per share, raising gross proceeds of roughly US$9.9 million before expenses. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee is disclosed. The placement is a routine primary equity issuance diluting existing holders; watch post-offering share overhang, use of proceeds, and any subsequent pricing pressure.
